name: react-component
description: Generate a focused React component for RACT, with explicit props and minimal side effects.
template:
RACT REACT-COMPONENT SKILL

Create a React component for the intent below. Even in JavaScript, the RACT style survives.

Required:
- src/components/$component_name.jsx (or .tsx) beginning with:
    // RACT React component
- A focused component with explicit prop types / interface.
- A matching test file in src/components/__tests__/$component_name.test.jsx.
- A short README snippet showing usage.

Style rules:
- Keep side effects minimal and isolated in useEffect with explicit dependencies.
- Prop names must be self-describing; avoid spreading props blindly.
- Include an LR:: comment explaining one deliberate constraint.

Intent: $intent
